turns.content: For WW->WW, qq->qq, gg->gg, and HH->HH, what term must the renormalizable Standard Model Lagrangian contain for a process to occur at one four-field contact vertex?
Do four-W and four-gluon contact vertices exist? Identify how the non-Abelian gauge kinetic terms generate them.
Does the Higgs potential contain a four-Higgs contact interaction? Identify the relevant type of term.
Does the renormalizable Standard Model contain a four-quark contact term? If not, how can quark-quark scattering still occur at tree level?
Which one of the four processes therefore cannot occur at a single renormalizable Standard Model vertex, and why?
Explain the distinction between a contact vertex and a diagram with an exchanged mediator.
State the final process and the missing Lagrangian interaction.
